command: TBS_CASE_SUITE=full TBS_METHODS=tbs,tbs_continuous_guarded_within_covariance TBS_ENABLE_PLOTS=0 TBS_RUN_RELATIONSHIP_ANALYSIS=0 TBS_RUN_DIR=... TBS_N_JOBS=1 uv run python benchmarks/full/run.py
notes: Run after removing the continuous-feature-space skip guard from the guarded covariance candidate.
The candidate now runs on all feature representations; guarded within-child covariance still activates only on continuous blocks.
Global fixed-coordinate BH gate improves continuous Gaussian failures and removes many default TBS empirical-null skips, but regresses many binary/categorical/sequence cases relative to default TBS.
